findings.title: Disposed deep-link listeners can navigate and create/send through an old workspace closure
findings.cause: The effect subscribed an unfenced IPC callback and returned only transport unsubscribe. A retained callback invoked old navigate, whose dynamic owner read accepted the current owner while using its captured old workspaceId.
findings.impact: Cross-workspace session creation/message action and explicit selection loss violate UI001.1 preservation requirement.

repair.behavior: Capture committed owner and local active lease in the deep-link subscription effect; reject disposed/foreign owners before route/action dispatch, deactivate before transport unsubscribe.
